description: This file defines the SerialPortList class in the jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector) library. It provides methods to retrieve the list of available serial port names on various operating systems, incorporating pattern matching and sorting capabilities.

classes.name: SerialPortList
classes.description: Provides static methods to detect available serial ports across different operating systems with customizable sorting and pattern matching.

methods.name: getPortNames
methods.description: Retrieve an array of available serial port names in the system using default or specified search path, pattern, or comparator.

methods.name: getPortNames(String)
methods.description: Retrieve serial port names in the specified search path.

methods.name: getPortNames(Pattern)
methods.description: Retrieve serial port names matching the specified regex pattern.

methods.name: getPortNames(Comparator)
methods.description: Retrieve serial port names sorted by the given comparator.

methods.name: getPortNames(String, Pattern)
methods.description: Retrieve serial port names in the specified path matching the regex pattern.

methods.name: getPortNames(String, Comparator)
methods.description: Retrieve serial port names in the specified path sorted by the given comparator.

methods.name: getPortNames(Pattern, Comparator)
methods.description: Retrieve system port names matching pattern and sorted by comparator.

methods.name: getPortNames(String, Pattern, Comparator)
methods.description: Retrieve port names in specified path matching pattern and sorted by comparator.
